companies.name: TCS
companies.oaPattern: NQT → Digital/Prime separation; coding + aptitude + verbal
companies.resume: Clean 1-page; academics visible; 2 projects max highlighted
companies.projects: Important for Digital/Prime—not just NQT pass
companies.strategy: Clear NQT first. Parallel: 30 easy–medium DSA. Polish HireLens/Anony Talk bullets for Digital.

companies.name: Infosys
companies.oaPattern: Online assessment + HackWithInfy path for better roles
companies.projects: Medium importance—explain stack clearly
companies.strategy: HackWithInfy if confident in UI/projects. Otherwise mass hiring OA focus.

companies.name: Wipro
companies.resume: Simple format; avoid over-design in PDF
companies.projects: Explain one full-stack or frontend project
companies.strategy: High-volume apply strategy. Low DSA depth OK if OA cleared.

companies.name: Cognizant
companies.projects: Valued in GenC Next / digital roles
companies.strategy: Target GenC Next if projects strong (your profile fits).

companies.name: Accenture
companies.projects: Full-stack narrative helps
companies.strategy: Emphasize product thinking from Anony Talk for digital roles.

companies.name: Capgemini
companies.projects: Explain role in team projects
companies.strategy: Backup mass recruiter; maintain pipeline.

companies.name: Deloitte
companies.oaPattern: Aptitude + case-style questions for some tracks
companies.projects: Strong for Analyst/Engineering hybrid roles
companies.strategy: Apply if GPA/communication strong; prep case-style HR.

companies.name: Tech Mahindra
companies.projects: One good demo project
companies.strategy: Safety net company in portfolio.

companies.name: Product Companies
companies.oaPattern: 2–4 OA rounds: DSA mediums + MCQs; system design lite later
companies.resume: Impact metrics; links to live demos/GitHub
companies.projects: Critical differentiator for frontend/product roles
companies.strategy: Your path: frontend/product engineer—portfolio > 500 CP problems.

companies.name: Startups
companies.oaPattern: Take-home + live coding + culture fit; often no standardized OA
companies.communication: Authentic, curious, show what you shipped
companies.projects: Primary hiring signal
companies.strategy: Lead with HireLens + Anony Talk demos; contribute to open source.
